title: Transport of the intrinsic direct-image comparisons through a fixed mate
statement: For finite coefficients and composable scheme maps, the two normalized derived direct-image comparisons followed by any fixed-scalar conjugate agree with the corresponding transported mate coordinate.

source.place: The comparison-square naturality substep of the intrinsic direct compositor normalization.

proof.text: For a comparison c: e₁.functor ⋙ R′ ≅ R ⋙ e₀.functor, expand the definition of sfIntrinsicTransportRight. Naturality of e₀.counitIso.inv moves its component past e₀.functor.map(e₀.inverse.map(-)); the equivalence triangle e₀.counitIso_functor_comp then cancels the remaining unit. This proves the single-comparison normalization at every object N.

Specialize the single-comparison normalization to N=e₁.functor.obj M and append R.map(e₁.unitIso.inv.app M). Naturality of c moves this unit inverse across c; functoriality and e₁.counitIso_functor_comp cancel it with the source counit inverse. This recovers c.hom.app M.

Apply the normalized identity to the f comparison. Use naturality of the g comparison to move its resulting morphism across the comparison square, and apply the first identity to the g comparison. For any natural transformation α: Rf ⋙ Rg ⟶ Rgf, its naturality moves the last source-unit inverse past α. Functoriality combines the resulting maps into exactly sfIntrinsicAmbientCoordinate. Specialize α to conjugateEquiv of k.hom; conjugateIsoEquiv has this hom by definition.

proof_origin.place: Comparison-square naturality substep: a complete abstract equivalence calculation using naturality, functoriality, and the equivalence triangle identities; specialized to the fixed-scalar conjugate.

lean.statement: theorem sfIntrinsicDirectComparisonTransport (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A] {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (I : CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} A))) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective] (k : (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) (f ≫ g)).leftDerivedFunctor ≅ (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) g).leftDerivedFunctor ⋙ (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) f).leftDerivedFunctor) : (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage g A).map ((sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison f A).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) ≫ (sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison g A).hom.app ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) ≫ (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Z A).functor.map ((conjugateIsoEquiv ((derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) g).comp (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) f)) (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) (f ≫ g)) k).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) = sfIntrinsicAmbientCoordinate A f g I k
